coordinated_activities.activity: Working night shift as an aged-care support worker, doing overnight resident checks, personal care support and handover notes in a detailed written log
Commuting home by train and bus from the aged-care facility, messaging housemates by text to confirm quiet hours are respected
Making a light post-shift snack and a cup of tea quietly, rinsing dishes and wiping the bench before resting
Showering and changing out of work clothes, putting used uniform into the washing machine for a later cycle
Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on for white noise and the light off to keep the room quiet and dark
Washing face and freshening up after daytime sleep, hanging the washed work uniform to dry
Cooking a simple flexitarian lunch with the rice cooker and induction cooker, then eating and cleaning up
Studying at the desk with the lamp and computer, working through Master of Social Work coursework readings and adding notes
Boiling the kettle for tea and checking the weekly cash budget on the phone, planning grocery spending
Walking and taking the bus to the local shops to buy groceries for the week, paying in cash and comparing prices
Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner, labelling own leftovers in the fridge for the next day
Washing dishes, wiping shared benches and tidying the kitchen so it is clear for other users
Drafting a placement reflection and literature notes for the social work degree on the computer, using written checklists to stay on task
Quiet leisure at the desk, looking at the photo of the family dog in China and texting family a text-only update
Taking an evening shower, brushing teeth and preparing clean clothes for the next day
Setting phone reminders and alarms for the next rotating shift, packing the work bag and drinking a last cup of tea
Going to bed early to reset the sleep routine, light off and fan on for quiet rest
